source.text: If #MikeBrown is indeed the robber, where’s the red ball cap? Sandals? Stolen cigars? #ferguson

selection_rule: Kept 30 comments with explicit support or opposition to the source tweet questioning whether Mike Brown was the robber based on missing/unclear identifying evidence; excluded source duplicate, requests for context, off-topic arguments, personal insults, and ambiguous procedural comments; balanced 15 support and 15 oppose.
note: support = agrees with the evidence/identity doubt, treats the robbery story as distraction or fabrication, or argues the released robbery material does not address the shooting; oppose = answers the evidence questions by pointing to hat/sandals/photos/cigarillo admissions, or argues the robbery material is relevant to officer contact/context.
